args.body:
Combined summary of Brightline's cold-chain article (https://blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain) and its companion piece (https://insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion):

• In 2026 cold-chain logistics, temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data.
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
• The companion piece reports that pilot programs cut claims by a quarter (25%).
args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026 — Brightline article + companion summary
